# gradle-wrapper.jar

Source: [priperi/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar](../../../../../priperi/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar)

Bootstraps the Gradle distribution. It is build tooling, not an account archive.

This file is compiled or packaged by the Android build. See [Build](../../../../../docs/BUILD.md). It has no private value to paste unless its configuration note says otherwise.
